issues_in.problem: “表里的315对37，覆盖两家公司的全部供水户”——证据（W-E8）只说表九统计的是“两家公司供水人口”的死亡比，未说明是两家公司的全部供水户；结合W-E11/W-E12，调查范围是南部混供区的住户，“全部”属超出证据的范围断言

edits_applied.before: 作者的解读：两组数字方向一致。肯宁顿的38户对4户，来自同一片混供街区；表里的315对37，覆盖两家公司的全部供水户，而伦敦其余地区的59恰好落在两者之间。接兰贝斯水的人家，死亡率比全城其余地方还低；接南华克和沃克斯霍尔水的人家，高出好几倍。如果是街区或空气在起作用，同一片街区里的两组人家不该分得这么开。这层推理是作者补的；斯诺本人的论证集中在供水与死亡的对应上。

edits_applied.before: The author's reading: the two sets of figures point the same way. Kennington's 38 houses against 4 came from the same intermixed streets; the table's 315 against 37 covers every house each company supplied, with the rest of London's 59 falling between them. Houses on Lambeth water died at a lower rate than the rest of the city, houses on Southwark and Vauxhall water at several times it. If the neighbourhood or the air were doing the killing, two sets of houses in the same streets should not have split so far apart. That step is the author's; Snow's own argument rested on the correspondence between the water and the deaths.

dispositions.reason: 已修好：中英文同步删去范围断言“全部”/“every”，改为“覆盖两家公司的供水户”/“covers the houses each company supplied”。W-E8原文只说表九统计“the population supplied by the Southwark and Vauxhall Company... that supplied by the Lambeth Company”，并未说明是两家公司的全部供水户；结合W-E11/W-E12（调查限于“those districts where the supply of the two Companies is intermingled”），“全部”确属超出证据，故不予保留。
